newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Illovo plans Swaziland bourse listing.
newsitem.headline: Illovo plans Swaziland bourse listing.

text.p: Illovo Sugar Ltd said on Tuesday it was considering listing on the Swaziland Stock Exchange subsequent to its acquisition of a 60 percent stake in Swaziland's Ubombo Ranches Sugar Company.
Illovo plans to diversify its product range by concentrating on sugar-based by-products.
"The main person involved with the listing has been off ill but we are hoping that the listing will take place as soon as possible," managing director of Illovo Don McCleod told Reuters.
He said they were looking at the expansion potential of marginal operations.

Illovo, which has a 44 percent domestic market share, has become Afica's largest sugar group after buying 94 percent of Lonrho Sugar Corp Ltd and will be one of the world's lowest-cost sugar producers.
The formalities of the acquisition are expected to be completed next Friday.
